payload.text: The neighbour brought fresh lemons. A small kindness that stayed with me all afternoon.
A café walk with a friend. We took the long way home and had nowhere else to be.
Rain on the window, a warm cup of tea, and ten quiet minutes before the day began.
The library gave me a moment to breathe. I found a book I had forgotten I wanted to read.
Someone let me merge into traffic with a smile. Such a small thing, but it softened a difficult morning.

The garden smelled wonderful after the rain. I noticed the first new leaves on the lemon tree.

I stayed outside longer than I planned, listening to the birds and watching the light change. It reminded me that I do not have to rush every moment of the day. There is room to stop and look around.

Later, I sent a photo to a friend who loves gardening, and we ended up talking about the gardens we remember from childhood. I am grateful for the way an ordinary afternoon can become a connection.
A friend checked in. I felt remembered.
The neighbour brought fresh lemons. A small kindness that stayed with me all afternoon. We made lemon cake together that evening.
